SIMPLIFIED WIRING SYSTEM (SWS)
54B-65
CIRCUIT OPERATION
The ETACS-ECU operates the horns through the 
keyless entry system answerback or the theft-alarm 
system if the requirements for the horns are satisfied.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
The turn-signal light and the horn answerback 
functions can be selected by the driver's desire (can 
be deactivated). However, the interior lights 
answerback function can not be deactivated. If all of 
these devices do not operate through the 
answerback function, the ETACS-ECU may be 
defective.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the turn-signal light
• Malfunction of the horn
• Malfunction of the dome light
• Malfunction of the ETACS-ECU
• Damaged harness wires or connectors
